scope: Controlled starvation diagnosis, not a throughput benchmark. The original untraced full-campaign timeout cannot be uniquely attributed; this experiment reproduces its symptom and isolates the helper scheduling policy.
platform: macOS arm64, MacBook Pro M5, AC power, .NET SDK 10.0.203 / CoreCLR 10.0.7
candidate_change: Only --fix retains the inherited launch budget; no deadline changes. BSD nice remains inherited.
fixture: ara-play-host source_fixes::code_fixes_use_prepared_source_ops_and_round_trip_offline_history, instrumentation+gpu profiling features, native test nice 10
load: 60 owned foreground Python PBKDF2 CPU workers (four per available core); same settings in both trials, sequential; workers terminated/reaped after each trial. This intentionally exceeds ordinary load.
other_checks: 15-worker cases and I/O-load cases passed before this change; source-fix host materialization took milliseconds. Temporary trace instrumentation removed after diagnosis.
limits: One severe-load trial per policy, no confidence interval or steady-state speedup claim. Inventory retained its background policy and its variable duration is reported separately.
